items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Then there are other people who I heard that I couldn't digest, because I didn't remember until later years, like Johnson was there

ctx.x: No, I was with Cab Calloway. And all of these things coincide, and it's so very important that, for posterity that these things be recorded.

Then there are other people who I heard that I couldn't digest, because I didn't remember until later years, like Johnson was there -- oh, it's just impossible, you have to go through the archives of jazz to find out who was living there and playing there then.

(UNINTELLIGIBLE) and they came over to Chicago; I can tell you the years that they came to Chicago from Kansas City, because the whole migration was south and the middle west, and Chicago, which was the hot bed of jazz, even before New York.
